description: Translate an ad's copy into one target language (one request per language; Arabic right-to-left), keeping its layout, logos, brand type and product; exact_copy pins pre-approved wordings line by line. Takes the ad as a local file, a public https URL or an Ideogram asset. Results are saved to the output directory; long jobs come back as a generation_id for ideogram_generation; ideogram_quote prices a call first.

exact_copy.description: Pre-approved wordings, one `original => replacement` per line; each names the text element showing original and sets it to replacement

image.description: The source photo or ad to work on: a local image file or a public https URL (image_asset_identifier for an Ideogram asset)

image_asset_identifier.description: An Ideogram asset (an upload or an earlier result) instead of a local image

inline_images.description: true: each saved image is also returned as image content (base64; one over 3.75 MB, or past 10 MB in total, by path only), for a client without file access

language.description: The target language of the copy (one request per language; Arabic is rendered right-to-left)

num_images.description: How many outputs to make (each is billed)

private.description: Keep the result out of Ideogram's public feed; true unless you set false (enterprise accounts are always private)

prompt.description: What to create or change, in natural language

quality.description: low, medium or high: higher may improve detail and takes longer

seed.description: Random seed for a repeatable result

wait_s.description: Seconds to wait for the result (0-50, default 45). The job is accepted first; if it is still running when the wait ends, the result is its generation_id for ideogram_generation (never resubmitted, never billed twice).

name: ideogram_ad_localizer
title: Ad localizer
